proposition: Shāhrukh b. Temür became governor of Khurasan in 799/1397, completed his Herat madrasa-khanaqah in 813/1410, abrogated the Yasa and enforced the Shariʿa in 813/1411, and by 815/1412 controlled Khurasan, Transoxania and Khwarazm; in the provinces, Fars was disturbed in 818/1415 and Bāysunghur named governor of Mazandaran and western Khurasan, Chaqmāq became governor of Yazd c. 823/1420, and Amīr Fīrūzshāh's family governed Isfahan in 827-28/1423-24.
